subject: Pilot cushion: short-term sandbox uplift after SDK freeze
messages:
From: Ellen Park <ellen@novusai.com>
To: camila_reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Cc: Ops Team <ops@novusai.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T16:12:00Z
Subject: Pilot cushion request — SDK adapter freeze blocking go-live

Hi Camila,

Quick context: we hit a blocker in our adapter to Redwood's HTTP SDK — a memory leak surfaced when our team upgraded to the new runtime last week. Our backend engineers are tied up on the fix; it looks like a 7–10 day sprint to stabilize and validate. That pushes our planned pilot traffic window past the sandbox credit window you provisioned.

Can you help with a short-term cushion? Specifically: an additional 50k token sandbox credit and a two-week extension on the pilot access while we finish the fix and run end-to-end regression tests. We want to avoid losing momentum with our product team and signal to leadership that we can still hit the Q1 integration milestone.

Attachments: integration_log_summary.txt (text), sdk_error_trace.zip (attachment)

Happy to jump on a quick call if helpful — I can pull in our lead engineer Darren.

Thanks,
Ellen Park
Head of Platform Integrations
NovusAI
From: camila_reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen@novusai.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-03T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Pilot cushion request — SDK adapter freeze blocking go-live

Thanks Ellen — sorry to hear about the leak. Appreciate the details and the attachments; the integration_log_summary is helpful.

Couple quick Qs before I escalate for an exception:
- Is the fix purely an app-level workaround or does it require changes to how you call the SDK (i.e., any breaking client changes)?
- Do you expect >2 weeks of rebuild/verification after the fix?

I can move this to our approvals queue, but I wanted to flag we'll need a short MOU/ack of the pilot dates and a confirmation that production keys won't be requested until we validate a stable runtime. If possible, please include Darren on the reply with a 1–2 line statement on the expected remediation timeline.

I looped Ben (CS lead) for visibility. If everything looks like a targeted patch, I can usually get a limited sandbox uplift approved quickly.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: camila_reyes <camila@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-04T14:18:00Z
Subject: Re: Pilot cushion request — SDK adapter freeze blocking go-live

Camila / Ben,

Reviewed Ellen's logs and the ask. Pattern looks like an application-side GC leak tied to an old runtime call pattern — no infra change required. Approve the following as a one-time exception for NOVUS-3421:

- 50,000 token sandbox credit
- 14-day extension to pilot window
- Conditional: Novus signs short MOU acknowledging extension terms (non-transferable, single-use uplift).

I will authorize in the billing console; Camila, please prepare the MOU and send the uplift confirmation to Ellen. Ben, loop in CS playbook doc if they need hands-on runbook support.

Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
From: camila_reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen@novusai.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-07T09:34:00Z
Subject: Re: Pilot cushion request — SDK adapter freeze blocking go-live

Hi Ellen — good news: Marissa approved a one-time uplift. Summary below and attached MOU draft:

- 50,000 token sandbox credit granted
- Pilot access extended by 14 days from the original end date
- Condition: sign MOU (attached soc2-request.pdf contains standard terms + extension clause)

I attached the MOU and included the HubSpot reference for your records. Please have an authorized signer return the signed PDF or confirm and we'll route a DocuSign link. Once we receive signed MOU I'll trigger the credit and reply with updated sandbox expiry.

Attachments: soc2-request.pdf (MOU draft)
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/record/67890
DocuSign (will send once you confirm): https://www.docusign.com/link/ZZY123

If Darren is available for a 20‑minute sync today, Ben and I can run through a short regression checklist to speed the validation.

Thanks — Camila
From: Ellen Park <ellen@novusai.com>
To: camila_reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Cc: Darren Liu <darren@novusai.com>
Date: 2026-12-09T18:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Pilot cushion request — SDK adapter freeze blocking go-live

Camila / Marissa — thank you, really appreciate the quick review and the uplift. Darren and I reviewed the MOU and we'll sign via the DocuSign link tomorrow morning.

Darren: we can take the 20‑minute sync tomorrow at 10:30am PST if that works for you — we'll have the fix branch and a short verification plan ready.

We'll confirm once MOU is signed and ping when we've validated the fix. Thank you for the help getting us across this pause — this keeps the pilot alive.

— Ellen
